programme.title: Raja
programme.desc: Madhu and Raja fall in love and decide to get married. However Madhu's two elder brothers oppose their alliance as Raja does not come from a wealthy family. As the story progresses the couple discovers that their families share a bitter past.

programme.title: Adventures of Tarzan
programme.desc: Upon his parents’ death in the jungle, Tarzan grows up as a jungle boy. One day, he saves Ruby, an explorer, who loses her way and they fall in love. However, when Ruby’s troupe tracks her down, they capture Tarzan to showcase him at a circus.

programme.title: Abhimaan
programme.desc: Subir, a popular singer in show business, encourages his wife and a talented singer, Uma to take up singing as a career. However, his pride is wounded and their marital bliss is threatened when Uma's popularity surpasses his own.

programme.title: Beta
programme.desc: Raju, an heir to millions of riches, is devoted to his manipulative stepmother who ploys to extort his wealth. But when Raju's newly-wed wife sees through her plan, she staunchly opposes her, which sets off a war of wits between the two women.

programme.title: Dil Vil Pyar Vyar
programme.desc: Three old friends, Krish, Hrithik, and Dev coincidentally participate in the same singing contest. Upon meeting backstage they realise their own reasons for participating in the competition and how far they have come in their personal lives.

programme.title: Pyar Hi Pyar
programme.desc: A CID officer Vijay is assigned to find Kavita's missing father. He ends up falling for her and tries to woo her, blissfully unaware that a seasoned criminal is out to sabotage his fragile family and love life.

programme.title: Amar Akbar Anthony
programme.desc: A family of five is separated in an unfortunate incident. The three brothers are raised in different religious households. As fate would have it, the family reunites after several years and avenges those responsible for their separation.

programme.title: Golmaal Returns
programme.desc: Gopal’s life hits choppy waters when he gets stuck on a yacht for a night upon rescuing an attractive young woman by fighting off some goons. Now, he has his wife suspecting him of having an affair and a police officer on his tail.
